senses.gloss: (transpos. of חצחץ, v. חָצָה; cmp. גִּעְגֵּעַ) to cut.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> (play on <he>יחצ̇אל</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 46:24">Gen. XLVI, 24</cite>) <he>מְצַחְצְחִין בשיניהם וכ׳</he> they cut with their teeth (make cutting remarks) and sneer with their lips.
